title: CNF length bound by circuit size
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, with size defined as $n$ plus its number of gates. The length of the CNF formula obtained from $C$ is at most $4\,\mathrm{size}(C)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
